씻다.x: I wash fruit well before eating it.
씻다.t: 씻다 is for body parts, dishes, food; for clothes use 빨다 / 빨래하다. Pronounced [씯따].

묻다.forms: 물어요 · 물었어요 · 물을 거예요 · 물으세요 (ㄷ irregular)
묻다.x: I didn't know the way, so I asked a police officer.
묻다.t: ㄷ → ㄹ before a vowel: 물어요. Everyday speech prefers 물어보다.

웃음.x: I burst out laughing when I heard that story.
웃음.e: From 웃다 'to laugh' + -음, which turns verbs into nouns.

잘생기다.m: to be good-looking, to be handsome
잘생기다.ex: 드라마에 나오는 그 배우는 정말 잘생겼어요.
잘생기다.x: That actor in the drama is really handsome.
잘생기다.e: 잘 'well' + 생기다 'to be formed': literally 'well formed'.
잘생기다.t: Use the past form for present looks: 잘생겼어요 means 'He's handsome', not 'He was handsome'.

된장.ex: 어머니가 끓여 주신 된장찌개가 정말 맛있어요.
된장.x: The doenjang stew my mother made is really delicious.
된장.e: 된 'thick' + 장 'fermented sauce': the thick paste, unlike runny soy sauce.
된장.t: Most often eaten as 된장찌개, one of the most common Korean home dishes.

된장찌개.x: The soybean paste stew my mom makes is the best.

살짝.forms: 살짝 + verb: 살짝 웃다, 살짝 닫다
살짝.ex: 아기가 자니까 문을 살짝 닫아 주세요.
살짝.x: The baby is sleeping, so please close the door gently.

하숙.ex: 대학교 때 학교 앞에서 하숙을 했어요.
하숙.x: In college, I boarded in a house near campus.
하숙.e: A rented room where the owner also serves meals; popular with college students.
하숙.t: 하숙 includes meals; 자취 means renting alone and cooking for yourself.

아늑하다.x: The room is small but very cozy.
아늑하다.t: Pronounced [아느카다]: ㄱ plus ㅎ becomes ㅋ.

건축물.ex: 이 성당은 백 년이 넘은 건축물이에요.
건축물.x: This cathedral is a building over a hundred years old.
건축물.t: Pronounced [건충물] — the ㄱ becomes ㅇ before ㅁ (nasalization).

관측.ex: 오늘 밤에 망원경으로 별을 관측할 거예요.
관측.x: Tonight I'm going to observe the stars with a telescope.
관측.t: 관측 is scientific observation of nature (stars, weather); 관찰 is close watching of anything.

건방지다.x: The junior acted cocky toward his senior.
건방지다.t: Usually said of someone younger or junior acting above their place.

마땅히.m: naturally, rightly, as one should, deservedly

소속사.x: The agency announced news of a new album.
소속사.e: 소속 'belonging to' + 사 'company': the company an artist belongs to.
소속사.t: Pronounced [소속싸]. News reports often quote 소속사 측 'the agency side'.

종량제 봉투.ex: 쓰레기는 꼭 종량제 봉투에 담아서 버려야 해요.
종량제 봉투.x: You have to put your trash in an official pay-per-bag trash bag before throwing it out.
종량제 봉투.e: 종량제 'volume-based fee system' (literally 'system following the amount') + 봉투 'bag'.
종량제 봉투.t: Pronounced [종냥제 봉투]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ. General waste must go out in these bags, sold at convenience stores and supermarkets; each city or district has its own design, so bags from another area may not be accepted.

보석.x: The court granted the defendant's request for bail.
보석.t: Homonym warning: 보석 (寶石) also means 'jewel'; context tells them apart.

편입되다.m: to be incorporated, to be transferred (into)
편입되다.x: The village was incorporated into Seoul last year.
편입되다.e: Literally 'compiled into' — added into a larger group.
편입되다.t: 편입 also means a college transfer: 편입 시험 is a transfer exam.

엄중하다.x: The government announced it will severely punish violators.
엄중하다.t: News collocations: 엄중 경고 'stern warning', 엄중 처벌 'severe punishment'.

진중하다.ex: 그는 나이에 비해 아주 진중한 편이에요.
진중하다.x: He's very serious and grounded for his age.
진중하다.e: Literally 'steady and heavy' — a person with weight.
진중하다.t: Don't confuse with 신중하다 'careful': 진중 describes overall bearing, 신중 describes care in decisions.

월등히.x: This year's sales are far higher than last year's.
월등히.e: Literally 'exceeding the rank' — far above the rest.
월등히.t: Pronounced [월뜽히]; used for comparisons where the gap is large.

효용.ex: 이 약의 효용은 아직 확실하지 않아요.
효용.x: The usefulness of this medicine isn't certain yet.

사상가.ex: 그는 조선 시대의 위대한 사상가로 알려져 있어요.
사상가.x: He is known as a great thinker of the Joseon era.
사상가.e: -가 = expert or specialist: 사상가, 작가, 전문가.

사익.ex: 공무원이 사익을 위해 권력을 쓰면 안 돼요.
사익.x: Public officials must not use their power for personal gain.

전역.x: My older brother gets discharged from the army next month.
전역.e: Literally 'turning from service' — leaving active duty.
전역.t: Use 전역하다 for the soldier; 제대 is a near-synonym heard in everyday talk.

고정 관념.ex: 여자는 운전을 못한다는 것은 고정 관념이에요.
고정 관념.x: The idea that women can't drive is a stereotype.
고정 관념.t: Collocation: 고정 관념을 깨다 (to break a stereotype).

불명예.x: He stepped down from his post in disgrace.

빈정거림.x: She laughed off her coworker's snide remarks.
빈정거림.e: Noun from 빈정거리다 'to make snide remarks' + -ㅁ.

삼권분립.ex: 삼권분립은 권력의 남용을 막기 위한 민주주의의 기본 원칙입니다.
삼권분립.x: The separation of powers is a basic democratic principle meant to prevent abuse of power.
삼권분립.e: Literally 'three powers standing divided' — legislative, executive and judicial.
삼권분립.t: Pronounced [삼꿘불립] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

추경.ex: 정부는 경기 회복을 위해 추경을 편성했습니다.
추경.x: The government drew up a supplementary budget to revive the economy.
추경.t: Common collocation: 추경을 편성하다 (draw up a supplementary budget).

지방분권.m: decentralization (transfer of power to local governments)
지방분권.ex: 정부는 지방분권을 더욱 강화하겠다고 공식 발표했어요.
지방분권.x: The government officially announced that it would further strengthen decentralization.
지방분권.e: Literally 'dividing power out to the regions'.

폐백.m: pyebaek (bride's formal greeting to the groom's family after the wedding)
폐백.ex: 결혼식이 끝나고 신랑 부모님께 폐백을 드렸어요.
폐백.x: After the wedding, we performed pyebaek for the groom's parents.
폐백.e: Literally 'silk offerings' — the gifts once presented; parents toss dates and chestnuts for children.
폐백.t: The verb is 드리다: 폐백을 드리다.

태동하다.m: to emerge, to begin to stir, to be born (of a movement or era)
태동하다.ex: 이 시기에 새로운 예술 운동이 태동했습니다.
태동하다.x: A new art movement began to stir in this period.
태동하다.e: Literally 'fetal movement' — the first kicks of something not yet born.

본령.x: Watching over power is the true mission of the press.
본령.t: Pronounced [볼령] — ㄴ becomes ㄹ before ㄹ.

난형난제.m: neck and neck, hard to tell which is better
난형난제.ex: 두 선수의 실력은 난형난제라 우승을 예측하기 어려워요.
난형난제.x: The two players are so evenly matched that the winner is hard to predict.
난형난제.e: Literally 'hard to call one the elder, hard to call one the younger'.
난형난제.t: Close in meaning to 막상막하, which is more common in everyday speech.

사생결단.m: a life-or-death resolve, fighting to the end
사생결단.x: He prepared for the exam with life-or-death determination.

천의무봉.m: flawless and natural, without any trace of artifice
천의무봉.x: His writing is praised as flawless and completely natural.
